agent_notes: 38 WebFetch calls. Quotes were taken from the WebFetch summaries (a small model), which can paraphrase; Seriously Fish quotes keep the page's '∗' sign. Seriously Fish text runs numbers together (e.g. '60 ∗ 30 cm24 ∗ 12 in'), so quotes stop after the cm figure. FishBase 80 cm wording reached only via fishbase.net.br mirror (others 403/refused); its unit is not labelled as length. Angelfish Fishkeeping World volume entry has a weak quote and should be dropped; fishtankadvisor, fishtanksetups, aquariadise, guidarium are lower-credibility hobby sites. Discus Seriously Fish 3-number size does not label height. Aquariadise kuhli '31.5 inches / 80 cm' quote may fail the script check.
